body.x: X-Beam Tech(www.xbeamtech.co.kr) introduced its extended beam optical fiber connector at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which runs Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

Unlike the PC type that transmits data by the actual connection of the devices, it uses optical signal with the lens. It is the optical fiber transmitter with multi channels with single or up to 4 channels.
Since the signal is sent in the form of light, it guarantees the stability of telecommunication even in shock, pollution, and vibration. It is also easy to maintain and sturdy.

It can be used in many industries that had difficulty in applying the system in the past like military, aviation, shipping, railways, heavy equipment, under water exploration, and broadcasting with the optimized solution.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
